no171.summary: Galeotto Fibindacci da Ricasoli, Florence's envoy at Urbino, reports to the Signoria (dated under the text 'a dì viij di settembre', year not written: 1423 or 1424, when he was sent to the Count over Faenza; the siblings of Feb 1424/25 are a later stay) on talks about the Countess ("Madonna", Caterina Colonna): he advises that the Dieci send an ambassador, because the Count says Madonna is after all a woman, and suspicious, and proposes that her relatives and the citizens secretly bind themselves whatever she might say.
